raw_response:
This plot is very small, just a small piece near my house, and sorghum is what I know. I have no money to buy a full bag of DAP or urea for such a little piece — one bag is too much and costs too much for me. I will put the manure from my animals on it like I always do, and use my own seed I kept from last harvest, because that is what my neighbors do too. I will weed it myself with my children's help, no hired hands, and pray the rains come well.
